method: Play-frame-clipped full two-dimensional five-cell square support; 8-connected eroded cores are compared inside every original 4-connected body to detect thin necks. Removed boundary components use rotation-invariant principal-axis length and width, not just four sampled directions. Every supplied short section is tied to its actual class/body and residual geometry.
